title: Will and Cipher
author: Zephyrine Delacroix
blurb: Ansel Pemberton, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
